description: This file defines the CountryService interface, which extends the SalesManagerEntityService and provides methods for retrieving and manipulating country data within the application.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: An interface providing country-related services, extending the generic service for entity management and adding country-specific methods.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Country object based on its ISO code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a given country.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches a list of countries filtered by language.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of country codes to Country objects for a specified language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries matching specified ISO codes and language.
